content:
tess (People Ops): Quick note: shared a short 'calibration reviewer checklist' that managers should use when prepping packets. please skim and give feedback.

mike (People Ops): Link: https://redwood.app/handbook/calibration-checklist  - it's a 1-pager with red flags and examples.

andrea (Manager - Product): Nice. does it include guidance on rating anchors?

tess (People Ops): yes 1 anchors for each bucket with example signals. also a short section on 'evidence vs. anecdote' and how to call out missing context.

kevin (Manager - Eng): Can ICs see the checklist or is it manager-only?

mike (People Ops): Manager-only for now; we don't want reviewers gaming wording. if teams want to share a sanitized version with ICs, that is ok.

zoe (IC - Design): Would be helpful to include recommended prompt language to ask reviewers for specific feedback (e.g., impact examples).

andrea (Manager - Product): good idea. can we add a sample email we can send to reviewers?

tess (People Ops): yes	added a sample blurb under 'reviewer outreach' that includes a 2-line ask and requested artifacts.

notifier-bot: Reminder: Packets due for cohort B  Apr 05 10:00 UTC.

kevin (Manager - Eng): One ops question: will People Ops spot-check packets for calibration readiness?

mike (People Ops): (typo) mike here  yes, we will sample ~10% of packets before the calibration window to catch missing evidence or inconsistent anchors. we'll DM managers with quick fixes.

andrea (Manager - Product): Thanks. can we get a short checklist PDF to attach to packet emails? saves copying.

tess (People Ops): Done	PDF and plaintext available at the link. if you want a custom cover note for your org, DM me.

zoe (IC - Design): Appreciated. will pass to design leads so we have consistent asks.

andrea (Manager - Product): Quick ask: can People Ops flag packets that are missing reviewer confirmations so we don't get surprised in calibration?

mike (People Ops): we'll add a 'missing-reviewer' tag to our sampling results and include it in the pre-calibration summary.

kevin (Manager - Eng): perfect. thanks all  i'll push to my managers in sync now.

tess (People Ops): thanks! ping if anything unclear.
